preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 100
preconditions.description: The first line of input is T, the number of test cases, where 1 ≤ T ≤ 100.

preconditions.expression: all(N == int(line) and N >= 1 and N <= 100 for line in stdin.split() if line.isdigit() and int(line) == N)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line is N, the number of strings and their length, where 1 ≤ N ≤ 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == N and all(c in '01' for c in s) for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.split() if not line.isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each of the next N lines is a binary string of length N, consisting only of '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line) == N and all(c in '01' for c in output_line) for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a binary string of length N, consisting only of '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line not in [line.strip() for line in stdin.split() if not line.isdigit()] for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: The output binary string for each test case is different from all given binary strings in that test case.
